comments.body:
RCA/final implementation note before close.

Confirmed mechanism: close_precheck emits completion sidecars through completion_sidecar.emit(result, material=None, repo_root=repo_root), and transition_close standalone verify-completion used the same material=None emit path; completion_bundle built atomic PASS payloads directly. The verifier already attached current plan material plus completion_read_basis (including receipt_digest) before emission, but build_payload ignored verdict["material_fingerprint"] when the explicit material argument was None.

Defect origin: caused_by olivine-married-kodiakbear / 24ec-c291-9f47-47fd, commit 2830f30f58ea61807ad96adc1257be04bebd3fa2, by scope-of-work: its plan promised durable completion FAIL verdicts including the ticket material fingerprint at verify time, but the implementation passed material=None and left the persisted record unattributable.

Fix: completion_sidecar now derives a composite sha256-16 material_fingerprint from the existing plan material fingerprint plus pinned completion_read_basis and prefetch manifest identifiers; PASS/FAIL sidecars carry material_basis and verifier_version. completion_precheck threads the prefetch manifest through completion_reconcile, atomic PASS passes repo_root to the builder, and completion gate_error_v1 records get completion-only material/version enrichment while plan/code-review ERROR records stay unchanged. Existing sidecars/readers are untouched and records without material/version remain readable as unknown-era legacy data.

Validation: RED oracle tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py::test_fail_emit_carries_pinned_material_fingerprint_and_verifier_version failed before the fix on missing material_basis/version, then passed. Mutation tooth reintroduced the builder omission and that held-out test failed, killing the mutant. Targeted regression suite passed (110 tests), make lint passed, make typecheck passed. Full local make test was attempted but stopped after unrelated pre-existing macOS safe.bareRepository=explicit failures in atomic bare-remote tests; the relevant non-remote atomic sidecar test passed, and Gerrit CI later supplied Verified+1.

Step-7 parity sweep: Serena/grep found completion_sidecar.emit at close_precheck, transition_close, tests/helpers; build_payload direct production caller completion_bundle; ERROR call sites gate_dispatch preflight and completion_failures mid-run through gate_error_sidecar; epic bug-screen tally uses a different schema and is N/A. All completion verdict/error paths are now covered or intentionally N/A.

Landed: Gerrit change 2473, commit 19d91550cf312057e9c091a7c39df595be500497 on origin/main, with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1; no unresolved comments.

compiled_state.description:
## Problem

Every COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar is emitted with `material=None` — `completion_sidecar.emit(result, material=None, repo_root=repo_root)` at `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py:405`, with the comment at `:754` noting no fingerprint is computed on this path. Measured on the live store: 0 of the most recent 300 COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecars (216 PASS / 59 FAIL / 23 no-verdict / 2 ERROR) carry any material/material_fingerprint field.

## Consequence (why this is worth fixing)

A FAIL followed by a PASS on the same `verified_at_sha` cannot be attributed: verifier inputs include ticket comments and prefetched evidence, which change without a code commit, so "no commit in between" does not mean "same inputs." This makes the completion gate's precision unmeasurable from its own records (an analysis this week mis-derived an "80–84% FP" figure from exactly this gap), and it means completion attestations cannot support the stale-material currency discipline that plan-review attestations already have.

Note: the `material=None` is deliberate per the code's own comment — this ticket treats the capability gap as the defect (operator-directed filing, 2026-08-31). Formula/prompt version stamping in the same record would make longitudinal gate analysis version-aware (pass-3 blocking formulas have changed over time, so unversioned sidecars conflate formula eras).

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecars (PASS, FAIL, ERROR alike) record a material fingerprint over the verifier's actual inputs (ticket material as pinned for the run: description/ACs/comments snapshot + evidence set identifiers), reusing the existing plan-review fingerprint machinery where applicable rather than inventing a new scheme.
- [x] Sidecars record the verifier formula/prompt version identifier alongside the fingerprint.
- [x] Existing sidecars are untouched (no backfill); consumers treat absent material as "unknown era".
- [x] A regression test asserts a FAIL sidecar carries a non-null fingerprint and version.

## File impact

To be confirmed at investigation (bugs do not pre-declare impact): expected `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py`, `src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py` (or equivalent emitter), one test module.

## Fix plan (2026-08-31, concise reviewed scope)

Root cause: completion verifier results already carry or can carry input identity, but `completion_sidecar.build_payload` only serializes the explicit `material` argument. Close-time and standalone emitters pass `material=None`, atomic PASS calls `build_payload` directly, and completion `gate_error_v1` records lack the same version/fingerprint observability. The change is additive record enrichment only: verdicts, close blocking, signing eligibility, and best-effort error swallowing must not change.

Fingerprint contract: new sidecars keep `material_fingerprint`, as sha256-16 over JSON schema `completion_verifier_material_v1`.

Normal pinned PASS/FAIL writes `material_basis="pinned_completion_inputs"` and hashes: existing plan-review material fingerprint (`current_material_fingerprint` / `pass1.material_fingerprint`), pinned `completion_read_basis` identifiers (`code_oid`, `tickets_oid`, `receipt_digest`, `run_id`), and `completion_prefetch_manifest` identifiers (`path`, `mode`) threaded from the precheck's `PRE-LOAD MANIFEST`. Mechanism: `completion_precheck` keeps `assemble_prefetch(...)->manifest`, returns it as `completion_prefetch_manifest`, the workflow YAML passes that output into `completion_reconcile`, and the reconcile op copies a non-empty list onto the verdict dict that close/standalone emitters already pass to `completion_sidecar.emit`; atomic PASS passes `repo_root` into `build_payload`. `REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH=0` produces an empty manifest but remains pinned when `completion_read_basis.receipt_digest` is present. Example basis keys: `{schema, material_basis, plan_material_fingerprint, completion_read_basis:{code_oid,tickets_oid,receipt_digest,run_id}, completion_prefetch_manifest:[{path,mode}]}`. `receipt_digest` is load-bearing because it covers the exact ticket/comments snapshot.

Fallbacks are explicit: `material_basis="unpinned_completion_inputs"` for legacy/local/deterministic precheck FAIL with current plan material but no read basis; `material_basis="error_unpinned"` for completion ERROR before a verdict result exists. If no ticket material can be read, material remains absent/unknown and the gate outcome is unchanged.

Version contract: every new completion sidecar carries `verifier_version={prompt_id:"completion-verifier", prompt_content_sha256:"<git-canonical prompt hash>", formula_version:"<signing.gate_code_version()>"}`. The sidecar emitter resolves `get_prompt("completion-verifier")`, hashes `canonical_prompt_text(...)` with `prompt_content_hash`, and reads `signing.gate_code_version()` independently, so the produce_completion_verdict preflight-ERROR path can stamp the same version even though no prompt step ran. If either lookup fails, that component is recorded as `unknown` without changing the gate outcome; old records without the field remain unknown era.

Shared ERROR scope: `gate_error_sidecar` serves plan_review, code_review, and completion. Enrichment is conditional on `gate == "completion"` only. Completion ERROR call sites covered: `produce_completion_verdict` preflight and `completion_failures.raise_completion_workflow_failure`. Plan-review/code-review ERROR shapes stay unchanged.

File impact: `src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py`; `src/rebar/_commands/completion_bundle.py`; `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_ops.py`; `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/completion-verification.yaml`; `src/rebar/schemas/completion_precheck_output.schema.json`; `src/rebar/schemas/completion_reconcile_input.schema.json`; `src/rebar/llm/gate_error_sidecar.py`; `tests/unit/test_completion_sidecar_material_balding.py`; `tests/unit/test_audit_completion_v2.py`.

Verification: (1) RED first: add a FAIL-sidecar regression test and run only it; it fails today because `material_fingerprint` is null and `verifier_version` absent. (2) GREEN: tests assert pinned FAIL has non-null version, `material_basis="pinned_completion_inputs"`, includes prefetch manifest, and its fingerprint changes when `receipt_digest` changes; also cover PASS direct-builder enrichment, unpinned FAIL fallback, completion-only ERROR enrichment, and plan/code-review ERROR non-enrichment. (3) AC3 reader proof: `latest_fail_verdict` / `latest_pass_record` still return legacy records lacking material/version. (4) Mutation-teeth in sandbox: reintroduce the builder omission; held-out FAIL test returns RED, then restore. (5) Focused sidecar/workflow/atomic-close tests plus lint/typecheck.

AC mapping: AC1 pinned PASS/FAIL fingerprint includes existing plan material, receipt digest, and prefetch identifiers; fallback values mark unpinned/error cases. AC2 is `verifier_version`. AC3 has no backfill/prune/reader rejection change. AC4 is the RED→GREEN FAIL test, including receipt-digest dependency.
